g.text: Processes and authority — C4 container view
Ravel — software boundary, not a sandbox
Boxes name processes or the external caller; cylinder: temporary files.
Blue: Ravel processes. Grey: external participants. Gold: temporary channel.
Arrows follow their labels; green arrows carry the opaque result.
1 precedes 2: the worker and managed process are not concurrent phases.
Before 2: worker ended and reaped; its private directory removed.
A valid selection alone is insufficient for launch.
The runner is library code inside the native front, not another process.
Angle brackets: element types. Square brackets: technology or interface.
Boundaries do not authenticate same-user code or contain detached children.
